import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { signInAsAdmin } from "@ds/e2e/admin-events";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { INVESTOR_REQUEST_CONSENT_VERSION_TAG } from "@ds/schemas";

/**
 * #4237 local drive (034 EARS-10) — never part of a CI config. Run with
 * `playwright.flows.config.ts`, workers=1, against an admin standalone build
 * proxying to an api on a branch DB with bot protection off.
 * DRIVE_MODE=main|head, DRIVE_OUT=<capture dir>.
 */
const MODE = process.env.DRIVE_MODE ?? "head";
const OUT = process.env.DRIVE_OUT ?? ".";
const ORG = `ООО «Партнёр А» ${randomUUID().slice(0, 4)}`;
const DESKTOP = { width: 1440, height: 900 };
const MOBILE = { width: 390, height: 844 };

/** The design-system `.dark` token block on the root (the #1927 recipe). */
async function dark(page: Page, on: boolean) {
  await page.evaluate(
    (value) => document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", value),
    on,
  );
}

test("4237 drive: «Заявки» investor filter, list, detail, status move, note", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize(DESKTOP);
  await signInAsAdmin(page);

  // The investor request comes through the real public intake.
  const res = await page.request.post("/v1/public/applications/investor", {
    headers: { "idempotency-key": randomUUID() },
    data: {
      contact: {
        organisation: ORG,
        fullName: "Анна Петрова",
        role: "Директор по развитию",
        email: `investor-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}@partner-a.test`,
        phone: "+7 900 000-00-00",
      },
      payload: { task: "Хотим войти в проект школы кардиологов" },
      consent: {
        accepted: true,
        versionTag: INVESTOR_REQUEST_CONSENT_VERSION_TAG,
      },
    },
  });
  expect(res.status(), await res.text()).toBe(201);
  const id = ((await res.json()) as { id: string }).id;

  await page.goto("/applications");
  const kind = page.getByTestId("applications-kind");
  await expect(kind.locator("option[value=investor]")).toHaveCount(1);
  const optionTexts = await kind.locator("option").allTextContents();
  console.log(`[drive ${MODE}] «Вид» options: ${JSON.stringify(optionTexts)}`);
  await kind.selectOption("investor");
  const row = page.getByTestId(`row-${id}`).first();
  await expect(row).toBeVisible();
  console.log(`[drive ${MODE}] row kind: ${await row.textContent()}`);
  await kind.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${MODE}-filter.png` });
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${MODE}-list.png`, fullPage: true });

  if (MODE !== "head") return;

  expect(optionTexts).toEqual(["Все", "Автор", "Партнёрство", "Инвесторы"]);
  await expect(row).toHaveText("Инвестор");
  await dark(page, true);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/head-list-dark.png`, fullPage: true });
  await dark(page, false);
  await page.setViewportSize(MOBILE);
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/head-list-390.png`, fullPage: true });
  await dark(page, true);
  await page.screenshot({
    path: `${OUT}/head-list-390-dark.png`,
    fullPage: true,
  });
  await dark(page, false);
  await page.setViewportSize(DESKTOP);

  await row.click();
  await page.waitForURL(`**/applications/${id}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-heading")).toHaveText(ORG);
  for (const label of [
    "Организация",
    "ФИО",
    "Роль в организации",
    "Рабочая почта",
    "Телефон",
    "Задача",
  ])
    await expect(page.getByText(label, { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/head-detail.png`, fullPage: true });

  await page.getByTestId("application-take").click();
  await expect(
    page.getByTestId("application-detail-header").getByText("На рассмотрении"),
  ).toBeVisible();

  // Reject path: a blank note is refused at the field, nothing stored.
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-input").fill("   ");
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-note-error")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-notes")).toHaveCount(0);

  await page
    .getByTestId("application-note-input")
    .fill("Созвониться в пятницу");
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-submit").click();
  await expect(
    page.getByTestId("application-notes").getByText("Созвониться в пятницу"),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({
    path: `${OUT}/head-detail-in-review-note.png`,
    fullPage: true,
  });
  console.log(`[drive head] OK id=${id}`);
});
